headline: Greeley Park Advisory Committee discusses Master Plan, park section use, Gazebo signage, and the Halloween "Boo Bash" on October 17th.
summary: The committee will review an aerial map of Greeley Park, discuss the Master Plan, and talk about park section use and management. They will also cover Gazebo reservation signage, future park improvements, and the Halloween "Boo Bash" event.
items: Review of Greeley Park aerial map
Discussion of Master Plan for Greeley Park
Discussion of use and management of sections of the Park
Signage for the Gazebo as to reservations and fee for use
Review of suggested future improvements to the Park
Discussion of the Halloween "Boo Bash" scheduled for October 17th, 4pm-7pm
location: Mines Fall Conference Room, 848 West Hollis Street
